verdict.rationale: Capacities documents one recurring scheduled job of its own: automated full exports can be set up under Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule. Nothing shows that users can schedule arbitrary recurring jobs, AI tasks or multi-step workflows; the AI assistant plans and proposes changes only on demand. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of user-defined workflows, recurring AI or agent runs, triggers or cron-style automation, and independent corroboration.
